steps.content: It feels like ages since she was swept into the center of the temporal storm, but Vanilla finally hears a familiar voice.

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Those who went to investigate the distortion field haven't returned. Something's not right; we need to go take a look. We'll leave it to you here, Vanilla.</color>

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>There's still some distance to the danger zone, but space-time distortion is a trap, no one can predict what will happen. If we don't come back in time, you should pack up and return to the main camp as soon as possible.</color>
Before she can respond, another voice takes over.
<color=#7683a2>I can't leave, there's still a lot of equipment to fix. Don't worry, I can guard the camp. I'm good at waiting.</color>
It's her own voice, Vanilla sees another "her" waving goodbye to her companions. It's like she's watching a movie that records her unremarkable days.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: I know these... I did the same. I stayed and waited for them to come back.
She keeps waiting.
One day, two days.

Three days, four days, five days... how long has it been like this? "Vanilla" quickly notices something out of the ordinary: defeated and broken monsters reappeared, used supplies being restored... The time around the camp is jumping, overlapping, and disordered.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>...Has the distortion field moved here? Looks like I'm the one being trapped now.</color>

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Heh, good thing the others left the camp, they should be safe.</color>

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Keep it up, scientists, keep heading toward the future you yearn for. The life of a logistician in exchange for all your safety, it's totally worth it.</color>

She calmly accepts her fate. Just like her days in the outpost, she tinkers with the mech to pass the time, and watches the same unchanging scenery every day. She's already used to living and waiting in this eternal stillness.
...Until someone else desperately breaks into the temporal storm to find her.
Yes, it's this moment. There's a commotion outside the camp, ${PlayerName} made a mess back then too.
"Vanilla" wears her armor and enters the storm, hoping to find the person in danger as soon as possible.

But the person who came is not ${PlayerName}, instead, "Vanilla" saved two of her teammates; one was already dead, the other severely injured. Shocked, she looks at their bloody wounds and feels a heart-wrenching pain.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Why did you come back to an abandoned camp? The temporal storm is still here; it's dangerous.</color>

steps.speaker: Injured Teammate
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>...Because you're still here...</color>

steps.speaker: Injured Teammate
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Don't worry, I'm not the only one who came, the others will be here soon... Oh right, time is distorted, you might have to wait a bit...</color>

steps.speaker: Injured Teammate
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Don't worry, as long as you're here, everyone will definitely come... to take you back...</color>

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>...Stop talking. Let's patch you up first before it's too late.</color>
"Vanilla" moves the teammate to the sickbed in the camp. After spending a dozen hours treating his wounds and watching over him, he's finally out of danger. She closes her eyes exhaustedly.
When she opens her eyes again, his bandages have disappeared, the sewn sutures have rotted and snapped, the infection has accelerated, and her companion died in front of her.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: ...This is not my time. I never experienced this... If I knew things would turn out this way, I would have...
She knows what "Vanilla" would do. The other her buries her fallen comrades and sits quietly in front of the graves for a long time.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>As long as I'm here, everyone will come back... You said that the temporal storm is a trap, so "I" am now the <color=#fb9259>bait</color> in the trap...</color>

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>...I'm the logistician, I'm supposed to stay put. You're the ones who are supposed to change the future... You shouldn't have gone this far for me.</color>
She stands up, looks at the camp, then at the forever half-repaired, damaged "mech." It can at least resist some dangers in the storm, perhaps it could bring her out of here faster.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>I can't stay here any longer. I... have to do something.</color>
"Vanilla" can no longer remember how long she's been trying to leave.

She's been pushing herself to the limit, working around the clock without any sleep. But the instant she dozes off, she finds herself engulfed by the currents of time, thrown back to where she started, or sometimes, even further back.
Her efforts are always easily erased, every step she takes is meaningless. Trapped in an eternal limbo, she can never reach the future.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>...It's just probability. This time the jump was short, only going back 30 minutes.</color>

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Given this is a rift of eternity, then surely not much time has passed on the outside. I can try as many times as I can bear.</color>

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>There's still time...</color>
As usual, she adjusts her armor and sets off again.
The mech treks across the wilderness, relentlessly marching forward... She journeys across boundless time, from the past to the future, as everything rapidly falls away behind her.
She mutters to herself, unable to think of anything else.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Almost there... almost done.</color>

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>This time... time is on my side...</color>

As time continues to leap forward little by little, she's gradually shrouded in Mania, and the polluted mech becomes the center of the storm. Guided by Mania, the mech marches on, and eventually stops in front of Vanilla. The story has reached its end.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>I... made it out...</color>

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Where... should I go...</color>

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Who... am I...</color>
Vanilla stands in front of the decayed mech. The separated timelines intersect and gradually merge. The audience from the past finally reaches the finale in the future.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: ...In the center of the storm, time is a tangled mess. My present, past, and future selves—each and every version of me may appear as an independent entity.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: So that's it... Like you said, anyone can leave, change, and reach an ending they've never imagined... This is the end of the mechanic, the real Vanilla.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: And I'm just a shadow from the past, a phantom in the storm, an existence that was only momentarily anchored by that child.
She gently caresses the mech she crafted with her own hands, which has now become weathered and decayed.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: I'm but a fleeting moment of coincidence in this eternity, and will eventually meet a quiet end...
With a blinding red light, the illusion is broken, and Vanilla finds herself bound in the polluted metal.
The Illusory Moon is squirming in the sky. The red light falls and turns into pollution, and that child is fighting desperately.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Grab my hand and come with me! Don't be shaken! You're still alive and well. Let's leave this place together!

Vanilla is momentarily taken aback. Can he still be called a "child"? He's much taller now, and his gaze has hardened. He's suffered a lot of injuries as well. If it wasn't for that earring, Vanilla wouldn't recognize the little guide at all.
steps.female_content: Vanilla is momentarily taken aback. Can she still be called a "child"? She's much taller now, and her gaze has hardened. She's suffered a lot of injuries as well. If it wasn't for that earring, Vanilla wouldn't recognize the little guide at all.

steps.content: Is this also the effect of the temporal storm? To think that she can witness such an incredible miracle... And on the face of that miraculous person, there seem to be trails of tears.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: So you've also seen everything too... I'm not the Vanilla you're looking for. The real Vanilla has already—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That was an illusion! A trap created by the Illusory Moon, DisSea, and Mania to blind you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It was the same for Dreya and Mantis. Those bastards like to peek into your minds, make use of your wishes or weaknesses. It's trying to trap you, to keep you here forever.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll take you out. I won't leave you here!
What is ${PlayerName} talking about? Vanilla's not deceived by any red moon. She's very clear-headed now, surprisingly.
She sees the twisted moonlight wrapping around ${PlayerName}'s body. The red light has dyed his eyes crimson. His voice is wild and hoarse, his expression filled with immense pain.
steps.female_content: She sees the twisted moonlight wrapping around ${PlayerName}'s body. The red light has dyed her eyes crimson. Her voice is wild and hoarse, her expression filled with immense pain.

steps.content: The polluted mech roars loudly, trying desperately to push ${PlayerName} away, yet not to harm this person at the same time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The polluted mech seems to be preventing someone from approaching...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This temporal storm, it seems to be created to trap someone...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I enjoy spending time with you.

steps.speaker: Injured Teammate
steps.content: As long as you're here, everyone will definitely come... to take you back...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><size=44>I will take you back!</color></size>
Countless memories flash through in her mind, but the mechanic quickly sorts them out. She notices a sinister scheme amidst the anomalies.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: ...The temporal storm is a trap, and "I" am a separate illusion within it, a bait in the trap. Is this... a coincidence?

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: The trap doesn't just trap me. It also traps the people who come to save me...

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: And the one who created this fake Vanilla to lure that child is... <color=#fb9259>you</color>...

She looks up at the Illusory Moon in the sky. It writhes and twists, its evil pulsations radiating greed. It eyes its prey, peering into his heart, grasping at his wishes and weaknesses... It wants to trap ${PlayerName}.
steps.female_content: She looks up at the Illusory Moon in the sky. It writhes and twists, its evil pulsations radiating greed. It eyes its prey, peering into her heart, grasping at her wishes and weaknesses... It wants to trap ${PlayerName}.

steps.content: Vanilla's body is merging with the mechanical remnants. The long years of memories are gradually corroding her thoughts, but she does not fear.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: So... what would the real Vanilla do in this situation?

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Would she succumb to her creator and fulfill the duties it gave her, or...
Smiling, she looks at the rusted mech, clenches her fist and raises her hand.

The mech creaks as it raises its arm high. A powerful force gathers at its front—it's the century-old temporal storm. It's now suppressed and controlled by a strong willpower, and turning into light in the rusty palm.
With a punch, the dazzling light instantly disperses the Illusory Moon's red light wrapping around ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Just like how my ten years at the outpost allowed me to master mechanics, my future self who has experienced eternity can also... master time.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: I'm close to that future now. Once I get there, I can use her power to send you back.
As the power converges in her hand, Vanilla's body quickly weathers and decays, just like her creation that has experienced countless temporal jumps over the unimaginable long period of time.
I don't want you to become like that！ We're leaving together! I came here for you. I won't leave without you.
Since this is a temporal storm, come with me to my time. I'll be with you no matter how many times we have to jump. We'll get there someday! You did the same thing!
You can't just stop here. Keep going, you can go even further into the future!

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Heh, you might have grown up, but you're still a child at heart.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Don't rush. Those who seek the future must have eyes to see the present clearly, you need to see your own path.

She takes off her goggles and puts them on your face. It blocks out the red light of the Illusory Moon, and the whispers in your head finally recede. Your restlessness fades, your breathing steadies, and you gradually see the face of the person in front of you.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: I'm different now. I'm no longer stuck in place. I embarked on a journey of my own, and reached... a decent endpoint.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Perhaps the scenery hasn't changed much, but my future is far from finished, it'll keep going.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: You will take it with you, and go far.
With the goggles adjusted, the broken lens refracts the chaotic time within eternity. She's smiling, but rapidly decaying.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: I've never seen other sceneries, so this desolate view is everything to me. But my teammates have always believed that the world can be changed, and the scenery you brought back far exceeded our expectations.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: I like the things that you told me about—the future city, the life you love, your new companions, and all those hopes you have for the future. Thank you for bringing these incredible memories here to see me.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: It's time to go back now. Go back to your time. Go on your own journey, and into your own future.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: This... is the meaning of our journey...

You don't know when she let go of her hand, her voice and figure gradually fade. At the same time, you feel something familiar from behind you while your head gradually clears. You know what this means.
—It's that stone slate. Vanilla's name must be on it, and lit up now to send you back. Everything is rapidly receding in your wake. She has harnessed the power to send you back to your time.
But this only fills you with panic, you walk toward her with all your might, trying to catch the figure disappearing into the storm.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can't stay here. Don't die, come with me! Vanilla...!
You want to dive deeper into the contamination. Your shackles are charged up, ready to unleash their power, when suddenly a burst of blue light pierces your vision.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: Chief!

The light pierces your body and mind, instantly robbing you of all your strength. You fall to the ground as everything before you shatters. Vanilla is gone when the light fades. It takes a long time before you regain consciousness and realize...
You're back, to the "present time," the future of N.F. 114. The members of FAC are guarding you nervously, clearly there are more elites than before.
Schorl floats before you, observing... or rather, scanning you.
You quickly realize what has happened. Despite your exhaustion, your anger ignites in an instant.

options: Did you use the "Rules" on me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I was so close to bringing her back! She's trapped in the DisSea. The Illusory Moon has caught her, and will continue to torment her!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Send me back. Someone is in the storm. I'll bring her back.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: The temporal storm has ended, Chief... there was no one else but you. You're the only one the Illusory Moon was attacking.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: Those things you saw were all illusions created by Mania to deceive you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She wasn't an illusion! They all existed at one point!
You struggle free of his grip and rummage in your coat, looking for the gift she gave you. You carefully tied it well on you so as not to lose it. Now you need it to prove that she's real.
...But you search everywhere, and there's nothing.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: That's the real Vanilla. I'm... just a shadow from the past, a phantom in the storm.
You finally lose all your strength, the fatigue and pain accumulated completely overwhelm you. Supported by an FAC soldier, you collapse, covering your face.
After a while, you hear some footsteps that cause a slight commotion from the crowd, but they quickly fall silent. Someone has arrived.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: Although the operation had many incidents, they were expected, and the emergency plan was effective. Good work, Chief. I believe you've collected some valuable information in this operation.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: So... who did you meet this time?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The logistician and mechanic of the expedition team... Vanilla.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: Vanilla... that's a name I've never heard of. Thank you for bringing it back.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: They chose their own paths without any regrets. They don't need anyone to save them.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: Yet, we now remember them again despite death and the passage of time—that's the greatest purpose of your journey.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: Do you want to see them again?
Surprised, you look up at him. The man remains emotionless, calmly looking at you and waiting for your answer.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: Good. Set out again when your emotions can't cloud your judgment anymore, and you're able to face all of this with a clear head.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: You'll be ready once your emotions can't cloud your judgment, and you're able to face all of this with a clear head.
He turns to leave. It seems he came here just to say these words. A few guards open up a protective shield for him, but he refuses.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: The Illusory Moon is receding, we'll recover the relics of the expedition team later.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: With <color=#fb9259>that</color> here, this place is very safe.
You gaze at the menacing mech that was originally covered in contamination. Its pollution is long gone.
Above the mech, some Hypercube flowers have bloomed. The soft blue glow blocks out the red light of the Illusory Moon, quietly embracing you all...
And within the cluster of flowers, there's a glint of light. It might have worn out a bit, but you recognize it nonetheless...
It's the pocket watch that the mechanic gave you.
